fusions.name: Green Shaft
fusions.desc: Looses a green shaft that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to take root in it and leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Yew at Full Draw
fusions.desc: Bends a yew stave to its limit and looses a shaft that deals 30 damage, rising to twice that at its full reach of 8 tiles. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Spring-Pole Snare
fusions.desc: Rigs a spring snare at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds; when an enemy comes within 2 tiles it springs, deals 20 damage to everything within 2 tiles and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Creaking Strain
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
